lines.text: و طالع اجتماع در اعلى الخصوص که قویتر باشد از استقبال باید دانست اگر چه لیلی باشد چنانکه
lines.en: And the ascendant of the conjunction in the highest particular, which is stronger than the opposition, must be known, even if it is nocturnal, as

lines.text: از کلام معلم اول مفهوم میگردد و طالع استقبال قویتر از طالع تربیعین باشد *
lines.en: is understood from the words of the First Teacher, and the ascendant of the opposition is stronger than the ascendant of the two quadratures. *

lines.text: ( احکام اجتماع در مثلثات اربع و بروج اثنی عشر ) مخفی نماند که قمر در اجتماع و همچنین
lines.en: (Judgments of the conjunction in the four triplicities and the twelve signs) Let it not remain hidden that the Moon in conjunction, and likewise

lines.en: in opposition, becomes inauspicious and of bad condition, and gives detestable effects, and confirming these words

lines.text: سلطان المحققین نصیر الملة و الدین طوسی است که در بعضی تصانیف خود فرموده است
lines.en: is the Sultan of the Investigators, Nasir al-Milla wa al-Din Tusi, who has stated in some of his compositions

lines.text: که الشمس بخیر القمر بالمجامعة والمقابلة وذلك لان القمر اذا كان في مقابلة الشمس فهو
lines.en: that the Sun harms the Moon by conjunction and opposition, and that is because the Moon, when it is in opposition to the Sun, is

lines.text: عند اخذ نورها يشبه في الضوء والتمام بها فيكون عند ذلك كالملك الذي يرفع الرعية
lines.en: at the taking of its light, resembling it in illumination and completeness, so it is at that time like the king who elevates the subject

lines.text: ويشرفه ويعلى قدره ومنزلته فاذا صار مثله في القدر والحال والقوه عاداه وحسده على
lines.en: and honors him and raises his rank and station, so when he becomes like him in rank, condition, and power, he becomes his enemy and envies him for

lines.text: حاله وقدره فاسقطه واهلكه واما المقارنة فانه لا قوة للقمر في مقارنة الشمس وذلك
lines.en: his condition and rank, so he brings him down and destroys him. As for the conjunction, there is no power for the Moon in conjunction with the Sun, and that

lines.text: انه متى يقاربها قد ارتجعت منه نورها وضوئها وصار الى جوهر البارد والرطب الذي هو
lines.en: is because whenever it approaches it, its light and illumination have returned from it, and it has become of the cold and moist essence which is

lines.text: اكره وابغض الجواهر اليها واحرنها ويكون كالوزير العظيم القدر والرياسة في الوزارة
lines.en: the most detestable and hateful of essences to it and the most sorrowful, and it is like the vizier of great rank and leadership in the vizierate

lines.text: يهبط عن مرتبته ورياسته ويصير الى العذاب والحبس من ملكه واهل احکام گویند که اجتماع
lines.en: who falls from his rank and leadership and goes to punishment and imprisonment from his king. And the people of judgments say that the conjunction

lines.text: مطلقا دلالت کند بر میل و ارتکاب مردم بکارهای نهانی و متوجه پادشاه و سلاطین
lines.en: absolutely indicates the inclination and undertaking of people to hidden affairs, and the attention of the king and sultans

lines.text: بر سولان و ایلچیان و جاسوسا و ساختن کارهای بیجماعت ( اجتماع نیرین در
lines.en: to envoys and ambassadors and spies, and the making of affairs without a group. (The conjunction of the two luminaries in

lines.text: مثلثه اتشی ) دلالت کند بر داد و عدل در میانه سلاطین و حکام و انصاف در میان
lines.en: the fiery triplicity) indicates justice and equity among sultans and rulers, and fairness among

lines.text: رفیقان و مصاحبان و شریکان و انواع احسان در میان ایشان و رسیدن نامها بدرگاه
lines.en: companions and associates and partners, and various kinds of beneficence among them, and the arrival of letters to the court of

lines.text: پادشاه و فرماندهان و تغییر هوا و خوف مسافران ( اگر در حمل باشد ) دلالت کند
lines.en: the king and commanders, and the change of weather, and the fear of travelers. (If it is in Aries) it indicates

lines.text: بر قوت حال ملوك و افت اغنام و اندوه عوام و صناع زر و سیم و تاریکی هوا ( و اگر
lines.en: the strength of the condition of kings, and the calamity of sheep, and the sorrow of the common people and the artisans of gold and silver, and the darkness of the weather. (And if

lines.text: در اسد باشد ) دلالت کند بر رونق احوال ملوك و التفات کردن بیکدیگر و ارسال رسل
lines.en: it is in Leo) it indicates the prosperity of the conditions of kings, and paying attention to one another, and the sending of messengers

lines.text: و رسائل و تحف و هدایا و اجتماع اکابر و اشراف در مجالس ملوك و حکام و مشورت نمودن
lines.en: and letters and gifts and presents, and the gathering of the great and nobles in the assemblies of kings and rulers, and consulting

lines.text: و بمیان اوردن اسرار و شدت حرارت در هوا و قلت ایذا (واگر در قوس باشد) دلا
lines.en: and bringing forth secrets, and the intensity of heat in the weather, and the scarcity of harm. (And if it is in Sagittarius) it indicates

lines.text: کند بر اندوه قضاة و اشراف و اهل قلم و افت دواب و رغبت مردم بعمل اتش و کیمیا
lines.en: the sorrow of judges and nobles and people of the pen, and the calamity of beasts of burden, and the inclination of people to the work of fire and alchemy,

lines.text: و اعتدال هوا و قبض خاطر بزرگان و کثرت بیع و شری و ستور و وقوع بارندگی و
lines.en: and the moderation of the weather, and the contraction of the hearts of the great, and the abundance of buying and selling and cattle, and the occurrence of rainfall and

sections.en: Conjunction of the two luminaries in the fiery triplicity

summary.headline: Conjunction in the Fiery Triplicity
summary.text: Judgments of conjunction and opposition of the Moon and Sun, citing the First Teacher and Nasir al-Milla wa al-Din Tusi on their harmful effects. The fiery triplicity is interpreted for general affairs and for conjunctions in Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius, including rulers, weather, travel, messengers, judges, artisans, alchemy, trade, livestock, and rain.
